topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
response: The 41% efficiency impacts link budget by reducing effective transmit power, thus affecting signal-to-noise ratio and coverage probability. This requires compensating with higher transmit power or antenna gain to maintain link quality.
reference_context: Link budget calculations consider satellite transmit power, antenna gains, and noise temperatures to ensure reliable transmission in SatCom systems.
